heroSummary: Anne Arundel County Public Schools begins the 2027-2028 school year with a staggered opening on Monday, August 30, 2027. Grades 1-12 open on Tuesday, August 31, and the official calendar lists Wednesday, June 14, 2028 as the last student day.
heroSummaryFacts: Grades 1-5 and grades 6 and 9 open first on Aug 30
calendarNotes: The AACPS 2027-2028 calendar again uses staggered openings at the start of the school year. Grades 1-5 and grades 6 and 9 begin on August 30, while grades 1-12 begin on August 31. ECSE, Pre-K, and Kindergarten use conferences and staggered openings from August 30 through September 7. October includes Yom Kippur on October 11 and a Project Unity two-hour early dismissal on October 19. November includes a teacher workday on November 1, an elementary and middle school closure on November 12 while high schools remain open, and parent-teacher conferences on November 22-23. Additional Project Unity two-hour early dismissals are listed on December 7, February 8, and March 14. Spring Break runs April 10-17, followed later in April by Primary Election Day on April 25. The calendar identifies June 14 as the last student day and June 16 as the last teacher day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does AACPS start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS begins the 2027-2028 school year on Monday, August 30, 2027 for grades 1-5 and grades 6 and 9 only. Grades 1-12 open on Tuesday, August 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AACPS Winter Break in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS Christmas/Winter Break runs December 24 through December 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AACPS Spring Break in 2028?
When is the last day of school for AACPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The official AACPS calendar lists Wednesday, June 14, 2028 as the last day for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Which AACPS dates are easy to miss in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Easy-to-miss dates include August 30-September 7 staggered openings, November 1 teacher workday, November 12 for elementary and middle school students, November 22-23 parent-teacher conferences, Project Unity early dismissals, and April 25 Primary Election Day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does AACPS publish a Spanish calendar for 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. AACPS publishes a Spanish version of the 2027-2028 school year calendar, linked as an alternate calendar on this page.
